scientific_integrity: Three-cycle count and interval from an earlier public classification are credited; exact new claims concern simultaneous primitive four- and eight-cycle existence and sharp conditional branch thresholds. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Proves at least three coexisting locally attracting cycles in each of two exact parameter intervals for specified symbolic itineraries; does not classify all cycles, global basins, outside parameters, or publication priority.
title: Sharp multistability windows for an isosceles farthest-projection map
